from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, BinaryIO

import pandas as pd
import pytest

REQUIRED_COLUMNS = ("name", "email", "role")
VALID_ROLES = ("admin", "editor", "viewer")
MAX_ROWS = 10000
MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH = 254


def read_users_table(
    source: str | Path | BinaryIO,
    filename: str | None = None,
    max_rows: int = MAX_ROWS,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Read a CSV or xlsx upload into an all-string DataFrame (at most max_rows + 1 rows)."""
    label = str(filename or (source if isinstance(source, (str, Path)) else "")).lower()
    options = {"dtype": str, "nrows": max_rows + 1}
    if label.endswith((".xlsx", ".xlsm")):
        frame = pd.read_excel(source, **options)
    elif label.endswith(".csv"):
        frame = pd.read_csv(source, encoding="utf-8-sig", **options)
    else:
        raise ValueError("unsupported file type: expected .csv or .xlsx")
    frame.columns = [str(c).strip().lstrip("\ufeff").lower() for c in frame.columns]
    return frame.fillna("")


def validate_users_upload(
    source: str | Path | BinaryIO,
    filename: str | None = None,
    max_rows: int = MAX_ROWS,
    valid_roles: tuple[str, ...] = VALID_ROLES,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Validate every row of an uploaded users file (CSV or xlsx).

    Returns a list of {"row": <spreadsheet row number, header = row 1>,
    "errors": [<reason>, ...]} for each bad row. All problems on a row are
    reported, and validation continues past errors. Values are never echoed.
    An empty list means the file is clean.
    """
    try:
        frame = read_users_table(source, filename, max_rows)
    except ValueError as exc:
        return [{"row": 1, "errors": [f"could not read file: {exc}"]}]

    missing = [c for c in REQUIRED_COLUMNS if c not in frame.columns]
    if missing:
        return [{"row": 1, "errors": [f"missing columns: {', '.join(missing)}"]}]

    bad_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    allowed = {r.lower() for r in valid_roles}
    for position, record in enumerate(frame.to_dict("records")):
        row_number = position + 2  # header is row 1
        if position >= max_rows:
            bad_rows.append(
                {"row": row_number, "errors": [f"more than {max_rows} rows; stopped"]}
            )
            break
        name = str(record.get("name", "")).strip()
        email = str(record.get("email", "")).strip().lower()
        role = str(record.get("role", "")).strip().lower()
        age_raw = str(record.get("age", "")).strip()
        local, _, domain = email.partition("@")

        problems = [] if name else ["name is required"]
        if not email:
            problems.append("email is required")
        elif (
            len(email) > MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH
            or not local
            or " " in email
            or "@" in domain
            or "." not in domain.strip(".")
        ):
            problems.append("email is invalid")
        elif email in seen:
            problems.append("duplicate email")
        else:
            seen.add(email)
        if not role:
            problems.append("role is required")
        elif role not in allowed:
            problems.append(f"role must be one of: {', '.join(sorted(allowed))}")
        if age_raw and not (age_raw.isdigit() and int(age_raw) <= 150):
            problems.append("age must be a whole number from 0 to 150")
        if problems:
            bad_rows.append({"row": row_number, "errors": problems})
    return bad_rows


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# pytest tests
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CSV_TEXT = (
    "name,email,role,age\n"
    "Ann,ann@example.com,admin,30\n"          # row 2: ok
    ",bob@example.com,viewer,25\n"            # row 3: missing name
    "Cy,not-an-email,editor,\n"               # row 4: bad email
    "Di,ann@example.com,viewer,40\n"          # row 5: duplicate
    "Ed,ed@example.com,superuser,abc\n"       # row 6: bad role + bad age
    "Flo,flo@example.com,editor,\n"           # row 7: ok
)


def test_csv_reports_every_bad_row_with_reasons(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "users.csv"
    path.write_text(CSV_TEXT, encoding="utf-8")
    result = {r["row"]: r["errors"] for r in validate_users_upload(path)}
    assert set(result) == {3, 4, 5, 6}
    assert result[3] == ["name is required"]
    assert result[4] == ["email is invalid"]
    assert result[5] == ["duplicate email"]
    assert len(result[6]) == 2  # role and age both reported, not just the first


def test_xlsx_is_supported(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "users.xlsx"
    pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "Name": ["Ann", "Bob"],
            "Email": ["ann@example.com", "bob@example"],
            "Role": ["admin", "viewer"],
        }
    ).to_excel(path, index=False)
    result = validate_users_upload(path)
    assert result == [{"row": 3, "errors": ["email is invalid"]}]


def test_missing_required_column(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "users.csv"
    path.write_text("name,email\nAnn,ann@example.com\n", encoding="utf-8")
    assert validate_users_upload(path) == [
        {"row": 1, "errors": ["missing columns: role"]}
    ]


def test_clean_file_and_unsupported_type(tmp_path):
    good = tmp_path / "good.csv"
    good.write_text("name,email,role\nAnn,ann@example.com,Admin\n", encoding="utf-8")
    assert validate_users_upload(good) == []

    bad = tmp_path / "users.txt"
    bad.write_text("whatever", encoding="utf-8")
    result = validate_users_upload(bad)
    assert result[0]["row"] == 1 and "unsupported" in result[0]["errors"][0]


def test_row_cap(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "many.csv"
    lines = ["name,email,role"] + [f"U{i},u{i}@example.com,viewer" for i in range(5)]
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    result = validate_users_upload(path, max_rows=3)
    assert result == [{"row": 5, "errors": ["more than 3 rows; stopped"]}]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("email", ["a@b", "@example.com", "a b@example.com", "a@@b.com"])
def test_invalid_email_shapes(tmp_path, email):
    path = tmp_path / "users.csv"
    path.write_text(f"name,email,role\nAnn,{email},admin\n", encoding="utf-8")
    assert validate_users_upload(path) == [{"row": 2, "errors": ["email is invalid"]}]
